subject: [RFC PATCH 09/18] mm: have folio_mark_accessed() return whether the folio is hot

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the `folio_mark_accessed()` function to return a boolean indicating whether the folio is considered 'hot' by the LRU (Least Recently Used) cache. A hot folio is one that has been recently accessed and is unlikely to be evicted from memory. The change prepares for future functionality where the caller can read the folios marked as hot without needing a reference to them. The patch also updates the function signature to return a boolean value instead of void.
